name: Arc length
formula: s = r θ   (θ in radians)

name: Circle area
formula: A = π r²

name: Circle circumference
formula: C = 2 π r

name: Cone surface area
formula: SA = π r (r + l),  l = slant height

name: Cone volume
formula: V = ⅓ π r² h

name: Cube surface area
formula: SA = 6 s²

name: Cube volume
formula: V = s³

name: Cylinder surface area
formula: SA = 2 π r (r + h)

name: Cylinder volume
formula: V = π r² h

name: Degrees to radians (Geometry)
formula: radians = degrees × π / 180

name: Distance formula
formula: d = √((x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)²)

name: Heron's formula: area
formula: A = √(s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c))   (s is the semi-perimeter, from the row above)

name: Heron's formula: semi-perimeter
formula: s = (a + b + c) / 2   (half the distance round the triangle)

name: Law of cosines
formula: c = √(a² + b² − 2ab cos C)   (C in radians)

name: Law of sines
formula: b = a · sin B / sin A   (angles in radians)

name: Parallelogram area
formula: A = base · height

name: Polygon interior angle sum
formula: sum of interior angles = (n − 2) × 180°

name: Pyramid volume
formula: V = ⅓ · base area · height

name: Pythagorean theorem
formula: c = √(a² + b²)   (hypotenuse of a right triangle)

name: Radians to degrees (Geometry)
formula: degrees = radians × 180 / π

name: Rectangle area
formula: A = l · w

name: Rectangular prism surface area
formula: SA = 2(lw + lh + wh)

name: Rectangular prism volume
formula: V = l · w · h

name: Regular polygon area
formula: A = ½ · perimeter · apothem

name: Rhombus area
formula: A = ½ d₁ d₂

name: Sector area
formula: A = ½ r² θ   (θ in radians)

name: Slope
formula: m = (y₂ − y₁) / (x₂ − x₁)

name: Sphere surface area
formula: SA = 4 π r²

name: Sphere volume
formula: V = 4/3 π r³

name: Square area
formula: A = s²

name: Trapezoid area
formula: A = ½ (a + b) h

name: Triangle area
formula: A = ½ · base · height

name: Alternating group order
formula: |Aₙ| = n!/2   (even permutations, n ≥ 2)

name: Basis
formula: A linearly independent set that spans the vector space

name: Coset
formula: gH = { g∘h : h ∈ H }

name: Cyclic group
formula: A group generated by a single element g: {…, g⁻¹, e, g, g², …}

name: Dimension
formula: The number of vectors in any basis of V

name: Direct product
formula: G × H = { (g, h) : g ∈ G, h ∈ H }

name: Direct sum
formula: A ⊕ B = { (a, b) : a ∈ A, b ∈ B } with component-wise operations; dim(A ⊕ B) = dim A + dim B

name: Direct sum: dimension
formula: dim(A ⊕ B) = dim A + dim B

name: Field
formula: A commutative ring where every non-zero element has a multiplicative inverse

name: Field extension
formula: A field K that contains F as a subfield; [K:F] = dimension of K as an F-vector space

name: Field extension: degree
formula: [K:F] = dim_F K   (the dimension of K as a vector space over F)

name: Galois group
formula: The group of automorphisms of K that fix F

name: Group
formula: A set G with an operation ∘ that is closed, associative, has an identity e, and every element has an inverse

name: Homomorphism
formula: A map with φ(a∘b) = φ(a)∘φ(b)

name: Ideal
formula: A subring I with r·i and i·r in I for all r ∈ R, i ∈ I

name: Image
formula: im φ = { φ(g) : g ∈ G }

name: Integral domain
formula: A commutative ring with 1 ≠ 0 and no zero divisors

name: Isomorphism
formula: A bijective homomorphism; G ≅ H means G and H have the same structure

name: Kernel
formula: ker φ = { g ∈ G : φ(g) = e_H }

name: Module
formula: Like a vector space but over a ring R instead of a field

name: Normal subgroup
formula: A subgroup N with gNg⁻¹ = N for every g in G

name: Order of element
formula: smallest k > 0 with gᵏ = e   (op = the group operation)

name: Order of group
formula: |G| = number of elements of G

name: Polynomial ring
formula: All polynomials a₀ + a₁x + … + aₙxⁿ with coefficients in R

name: Ring
formula: A set with addition (an abelian group) and associative multiplication that distributes over addition

name: Subgroup
formula: A subset H of G that is itself a group under the same operation

name: Symmetric group order
formula: |Sₙ| = n!   (all permutations of n objects)

name: Tensor product
formula: (a ⊗ b) = (a₁b₁, a₁b₂, …, aₘbₙ)   (Kronecker product of two vectors)

name: Vector space
formula: A set with vector addition and scalar multiplication over a field satisfying the vector space axioms

name: Arithmetic sequence
formula: aₙ = a₁ + (n − 1)d

name: Binomial theorem
formula: (a + b)ⁿ = Σₖ C(n,k) · aⁿ⁻ᵏ · bᵏ

name: Complex conjugate
formula: conj(a + bi) = a − bi

name: Complex number
formula: z = a + bi

name: Cube
formula: x³ = x · x · x

name: Cube root
formula: ∛x  (y such that y³ = x)

name: Difference of squares
formula: a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)  (returns the two factors)

name: Discriminant
formula: Δ = b² − 4ac  (>0: two real roots, 0: one, <0: complex)

name: Expand
formula: Multiply out products, e.g. (x + 1)(x − 1) = x² − 1

name: Exponential
formula: eˣ

name: Factor
formula: Rewrite a polynomial as a product of lower-degree polynomials, e.g. x² − 1 = (x − 1)(x + 1)

name: Geometric sequence
formula: aₙ = a₁ · rⁿ⁻¹

name: Imaginary unit
formula: i² = −1

name: Log any base
formula: logₐ(x) = ln(x) / ln(a)

name: Log base 10
formula: log₁₀(x)

name: Modulus of complex number
formula: |a + bi| = √(a² + b²)

name: Natural log
formula: ln(x) = logₑ(x)

name: Power
formula: aᵇ

name: Simplify
formula: Rewrite an expression in an equivalent, shorter or standard form

name: Slope-intercept form
formula: y = m·x + b

name: Solve for x
formula: Find the value(s) of x that make an equation true

name: Solve system of equations
formula: Find values satisfying several equations at once; for linear systems solve Ax = b

name: Square
formula: x² = x · x

name: Square root
formula: √x  (y such that y² = x)

name: Absolute value
formula: |x| = x if x ≥ 0, otherwise −x

name: Addition
formula: a + b

name: Division
formula: a ÷ b

name: Fraction
formula: numerator / denominator

name: Maximum
formula: max(a, b, …) = largest value

name: Minimum
formula: min(a, b, …) = smallest value

name: Modulo
formula: a mod b = a − b·⌊a/b⌋  (remainder of a ÷ b)

name: Multiplication
formula: a × b

name: Negate
formula: −x  (flip the sign)

name: Round down
formula: ⌊x⌋ = greatest integer ≤ x

name: Round nearest
formula: round(x) = nearest integer to x

name: Round up
formula: ⌈x⌉ = smallest integer ≥ x

name: Subtraction
formula: a − b

name: Curl
formula: ∇×F = (∂Fz/∂y − ∂Fy/∂z, ∂Fx/∂z − ∂Fz/∂x, ∂Fy/∂x − ∂Fx/∂y)

name: Definite integral
formula: ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx   (numerical: Simpson's rule with n subintervals)

name: Derivative
formula: f′(x) = lim_{h→0} (f(x+h) − f(x−h)) / 2h   (numerical central difference)

name: Differential equation
formula: An equation relating a function to its derivatives; see the Euler / Runge–Kutta operators to solve numerically

name: Divergence
formula: ∇·F = ∂Fx/∂x + ∂Fy/∂y + ∂Fz/∂z

name: Double integral
formula: ∬_R f(x, y) dA = ∫∫ f(x, y) dy dx over a region R

name: Gradient
formula: ∇f = (∂f/∂x₁, …, ∂f/∂xₙ)   (numerical)

name: Indefinite integral
formula: ∫ f(x) dx = F(x) + C   where F′(x) = f(x)

name: Infinity
formula: ∞ = value larger than any real number

name: L'Hopital's rule
formula: If lim f/g is 0/0 or ∞/∞ then lim f/g = lim f′/g′  (when that limit exists)

name: Laplacian
formula: Δf = ∂²f/∂x² + ∂²f/∂y² + ∂²f/∂z²

name: Limit
formula: lim_{x→a} f(x) = L  means f(x) gets arbitrarily close to L as x gets close to a

name: Line integral
formula: ∮_C F · dr = ∫ₐᵇ F(r(t)) · r′(t) dt   (∮ when C is a closed curve)

name: Maclaurin series
formula: f(x) ≈ Σₙ f⁽ⁿ⁾(0)/n! · xⁿ   (Taylor series about 0)

name: Partial derivative
formula: ∂f/∂xᵢ ≈ (f(…xᵢ+h…) − f(…xᵢ−h…)) / 2h   (point is a list, i is the variable index)

name: Product
formula: ∏ aᵢ = a₁ · a₂ · … · aₙ

name: Product rule
formula: (f·g)′ = f′g + fg′

name: Quotient rule
formula: (f/g)′ = (f′g − fg′) / g²

name: Second derivative
formula: f″(x) ≈ (f(x+h) − 2f(x) + f(x−h)) / h²

name: Second partial derivative
formula: ∂²f/∂xᵢ² ≈ (f(…xᵢ+h…) − 2f(…) + f(…xᵢ−h…)) / h²   (point is a list, i is the variable index)

name: Summation
formula: Σ aᵢ = a₁ + a₂ + … + aₙ

name: Taylor series
formula: f(x) ≈ Σₙ f⁽ⁿ⁾(a)/n! · (x − a)ⁿ   (derivs = [f(a), f′(a), f″(a), …])

name: Triple integral
formula: ∭_V f(x, y, z) dV = ∫∫∫ f(x, y, z) dz dy dx over a volume V
compute_signature: compute(f, x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1)

name: Adjunction
formula: Hom(F(A), B) ≅ Hom(A, G(B)) naturally

name: Aleph-null
formula: The cardinality of the natural numbers

name: Axiom of choice
formula: Every collection of non-empty sets has a choice function

name: Bijective
formula: both injective and surjective

name: Cartesian product
formula: A × B = { (a, b) : a ∈ A, b ∈ B }

name: Category
formula: Objects and morphisms with composition (associative) and identity morphisms

name: Complex numbers
formula: { a + bi : a, b ∈ ℝ }

name: Function
formula: A rule assigning to each element of A exactly one element of B

name: Functor
formula: A map between categories preserving composition and identities

name: Injective
formula: f(x) = f(y) ⇒ x = y

name: Limit and colimit
formula: Universal cone over (or cocone under) a diagram

name: Morphism
formula: An arrow from object A to object B in a category

name: Natural transformation
formula: A family of morphisms ηₓ: F(X) → G(X) that commute with F(f) and G(f)

name: Omega ordinal
formula: The first infinite ordinal, the order type of the natural numbers

name: Power set
formula: 𝒫(A) = set of all subsets of A;  |𝒫(A)| = 2^|A|

name: Product and coproduct
formula: Universal objects with projections (product) or injections (coproduct)

name: Quaternions
formula: { a + bi + cj + dk } with i² = j² = k² = ijk = −1

name: Rational numbers
formula: { p/q : p, q ∈ ℤ, q ≠ 0 }

name: Real numbers
formula: The complete ordered field: all rational and irrational numbers

name: Surjective
formula: every element of the codomain is f(x) for some x

name: Zorn's lemma
formula: If every chain in a poset has an upper bound, then the poset has a maximal element

name: Analytic function
formula: A function complex-differentiable in a neighborhood of every point of its domain

name: Argument
formula: arg(a + bi) = atan2(b, a)

name: Branch cut
formula: A curve removed from the complex plane so a multi-valued function (e.g. log, √) becomes single-valued

name: Cauchy integral formula
formula: f(a) = (1 / 2πi) ∮ f(z) / (z − a) dz

name: Cauchy–Riemann equations
formula: f = u + iv is complex-differentiable only if ∂u/∂x = ∂v/∂y and ∂u/∂y = −∂v/∂x

name: Conformal map
formula: An angle-preserving map; any analytic function with f′ ≠ 0 is conformal

name: Contour integral
formula: ∮_C f(z) dz = ∫ f(γ(t)) γ′(t) dt

name: De Moivre's theorem
formula: (r(cos θ + i sin θ))ⁿ = rⁿ(cos nθ + i sin nθ)

name: Euler's formula
formula: e^(iθ) = cos θ + i sin θ

name: Imaginary part
formula: Im(a + bi) = b

name: Mobius transformation
formula: f(z) = (az + b) / (cz + d),  ad − bc ≠ 0

name: Real part
formula: Re(a + bi) = a

name: Residue
formula: The coefficient of 1/(z − a) in the Laurent series of f about a

name: Residue theorem
formula: ∮_C f(z) dz = 2πi Σ Res(f, aₖ) over poles aₖ inside C

name: Approximately equal
formula: a ≈ b  (equal within a small tolerance)

name: Close bracket
formula: ) ends a group opened by (

name: Curly braces
formula: { … } denote a set or a group of terms

name: Equals
formula: a = b

name: Greater than
formula: a > b

name: Greater than or equal
formula: a ≥ b

name: Less than
formula: a < b

name: Less than or equal
formula: a ≤ b

name: Not equal
formula: a ≠ b

name: Open bracket
formula: ( begins a group; what is inside is evaluated first

name: Pi
formula: π = circumference / diameter ≈ 3.14159265…

name: Proportional to
formula: y ∝ x  means y = k·x;  returns the constant k = y / x

name: Square brackets
formula: [ … ] group an expression, or denote a closed interval [a, b] / a list

name: Christoffel symbol
formula: Γᵏᵢⱼ = ½ gᵏˡ (∂ᵢgⱼˡ + ∂ⱼgᵢˡ − ∂ˡgᵢⱼ)

name: Differential form
formula: A smooth, antisymmetric, multilinear field that can be integrated over manifolds

name: Exterior derivative
formula: d(f dx) = df ∧ dx,  d² = 0

name: Exterior derivative: d squared is zero
formula: d² = 0

name: Gaussian curvature
formula: K = κ₁ · κ₂  (product of the principal curvatures)

name: Geodesic
formula: A locally shortest path; ẍᵏ + Γᵏᵢⱼ ẋⁱ ẋʲ = 0

name: Lie bracket
formula: [X, Y] f = X(Y f) − Y(X f)

name: Lie derivative
formula: The rate of change of a tensor field along the flow of the vector field X

name: Metric tensor
formula: gᵢⱼ gives lengths and angles: ds² = gᵢⱼ dxⁱ dxʲ

name: Pullback
formula: (f*ω)(v) = ω(df(v))

name: Ricci tensor
formula: Rᵢⱼ = Rᵏᵢₖⱼ  (contraction of the Riemann tensor)

name: Riemann curvature
formula: Measures how parallel transport around a small loop fails to return a vector unchanged

name: Stokes' theorem
formula: The integral of dω over M equals the integral of ω over the boundary ∂M

name: Tangent space
formula: The vector space of all tangent vectors at p

name: Tangent vector
formula: The velocity vector of a curve through p on a manifold

name: Tensor contraction
formula: Sum over a paired upper and lower index, lowering the tensor's rank by 2

name: Wedge product
formula: α ∧ β = −β ∧ α  (antisymmetric product of differential forms)

name: Euler's totient
formula: φ(n) = number of integers in 1…n that are coprime to n = n · ∏(1 − 1/p)

name: Fibonacci
formula: F₀ = 0, F₁ = 1, Fₙ = Fₙ₋₁ + Fₙ₋₂

name: Greatest common divisor
formula: largest integer dividing both a and b

name: Least common multiple
formula: lcm(a, b) = |a·b| / gcd(a, b)

name: Modular arithmetic
formula: a ≡ r (mod m) where r = a − m·⌊a/m⌋

name: Pigeonhole principle
formula: Putting n items in m boxes forces some box to hold at least ⌈n/m⌉ items

name: Prime check
formula: n is prime if n > 1 and has no divisor other than 1 and n

name: Prime factorization
formula: every integer > 1 is a product of primes

name: Shortest path (A*)
formula: A* on the Dijkstra graph with node positions; straight-line distance to the goal; returns the path of nodes

name: Adjacency matrix
formula: Aᵢⱼ = 1 if vertices i and j are joined (undirected), else 0

name: Bell number
formula: Bₙ = Σₖ S(n, k)   (number of partitions of an n-element set)

name: Bipartite graph
formula: Vertices split into two sets with edges only between the sets (no odd cycles)

name: Burnside's lemma
formula: Number of orbits = (1/|G|) Σ_g |Fix(g)|

name: Chromatic number
formula: The smallest number of colors needed to color vertices so adjacent vertices differ

name: Cycle
formula: A path that returns to its starting vertex

name: Euler path
formula: A path using every edge exactly once; exists iff the graph is connected with 0 or 2 odd-degree vertices

name: Generating function
formula: G(x) = Σ aₙ xⁿ  encodes the sequence a₀, a₁, a₂, …

name: Graph
formula: A set of vertices V and a set of edges E joining pairs of vertices

name: Hamiltonian path
formula: A path visiting every vertex exactly once

name: Max flow min cut
formula: The maximum flow from source to sink equals the capacity of the minimum cut

name: Partition number
formula: p(n) = number of ways to write n as a sum of positive integers (order ignored)

name: Path
formula: A sequence of distinct vertices where consecutive vertices are joined by edges

name: Planar graph
formula: Can be drawn in the plane without crossing edges; then E ≤ 3V − 6 (V ≥ 3)

name: Recurrence relation
formula: Defines each term from earlier terms, e.g. Fibonacci Fₙ = Fₙ₋₁ + Fₙ₋₂

name: Shortest path (Dijkstra)
formula: Dijkstra's algorithm; graph = {node: [(neighbor, weight), …]}, returns {node: distance}

name: Spanning tree
formula: A tree that contains every vertex of G

name: Stirling number (second kind)
formula: S(n, k) = (1/k!) Σⱼ (−1)ʲ C(k, j) (k − j)ⁿ

name: Tree
formula: A connected graph with no cycles; a tree on n vertices has n − 1 edges

name: Vertex degree
formula: deg(v) = number of edges at v   (graph = {vertex: [neighbors]})

name: Angle between two orientations
formula: ∠ = 2 acos(|q₀ · q₁|) with both quaternions normalised (q and −q are the same orientation), from 0 to π radians

name: Characteristic polynomial
formula: p(λ) = det(A − λI);  for 2×2: λ² − tr(A)·λ + det(A)  (returns [1, −tr, det])

name: Column space
formula: col(A) = span of the columns of A = { A·x : x }

name: Cross product
formula: a × b = (a₂b₃ − a₃b₂, a₃b₁ − a₁b₃, a₁b₂ − a₂b₁)   (3D vectors)

name: Determinant
formula: det(A) = Σⱼ (−1)ʲ · A₀ⱼ · det(minor₀ⱼ)   (cofactor expansion along row 0)

name: Dot product
formula: a·b = Σ aᵢbᵢ = |a||b|cos θ

name: Eigenvalues
formula: det(A − λI) = 0   (closed form for a 2×2 matrix: λ = (tr ± √(tr² − 4·det)) / 2)

name: Eigenvectors
formula: A·v = λ·v  — solve (A − λI)v = 0 for v ≠ 0 for each eigenvalue λ

name: Identity matrix
formula: Iᵢⱼ = 1 if i = j else 0

name: LU decomposition
formula: A = L·U with L lower-triangular and U upper-triangular

name: Matrix add
formula: (A + B)ᵢⱼ = Aᵢⱼ + Bᵢⱼ

name: Matrix inverse
formula: A·A⁻¹ = I   (Gauss–Jordan elimination)

name: Matrix multiply
formula: (AB)ᵢⱼ = Σₖ Aᵢₖ · Bₖⱼ

name: Matrix rank
formula: rank(A) = number of linearly independent rows (pivots after elimination)

name: Matrix subtract
formula: (A − B)ᵢⱼ = Aᵢⱼ − Bᵢⱼ

name: Null space
formula: null(A) = { x : A·x = 0 }

name: QR decomposition
formula: A = Q·R with Q orthogonal (QᵀQ = I) and R upper-triangular

name: Quaternion conjugate
formula: q* = w − x i − y j − z k

name: Quaternion from axis and angle
formula: q = cos(θ/2) + sin(θ/2) · (the unit axis)

name: Yaw, pitch and roll to quaternion
formula: q = q_yaw q_pitch q_roll, with q_roll = [cos(r/2), sin(r/2), 0, 0], q_pitch = [cos(p/2), 0, sin(p/2), 0], q_yaw = [cos(y/2), 0, 0, sin(y/2)]

name: Quaternion inverse
formula: q⁻¹ = q* / (w² + x² + y² + z²)

name: Quaternion multiply
formula: Hamilton product of two quaternions (w, x, y, z), the second turn done first

name: Quaternion normalise
formula: q̂ = q / √(w² + x² + y² + z²)

name: Quaternion blend
formula: slerp(q₀, q₁, t) = (sin((1 − t)ω) q₀ + sin(tω) q₁) / sin ω, ω = acos(q₀ · q₁); the short way round (q and −q are the same turn)

name: Quaternion to yaw, pitch and roll
formula: yaw = atan2(2(wz + xy), 1 − 2(y² + z²)),  pitch = asin(2(wy − zx)),  roll = atan2(2(wx + yz), 1 − 2(x² + y²))  (q normalised first)

name: Rotate a vector by a matrix
formula: R v: the three rows of R times v

name: Rotate a vector
formula: v turned by q: q v q⁻¹ (the axes stay fixed; a q that is not unit length is allowed)

name: Rotation matrix from axis and angle
formula: the quaternion cos(θ/2) + sin(θ/2) · (the unit axis), then R(q); the axis is normalised first, the angle is in radians

name: Rotation matrix from a quaternion
formula: R(q) from the normalised quaternion (w, x, y, z): [1 − 2(y² + z²), 2(xy − zw), 2(xz + yw)], [2(xy + zw), 1 − 2(x² + z²), 2(yz − xw)], [2(xz − yw), 2(yz + xw), 1 − 2(x² + y²)]

name: Rotation matrix from yaw, pitch and roll
formula: the quaternion q_yaw q_pitch q_roll, then R(q)

name: Quaternion from a rotation matrix
formula: Shepperd's method: the largest of w, x, y, z is found first; the answer has w ≥ 0

name: Row reduce (RREF)
formula: Reduced row echelon form via Gauss–Jordan elimination

name: Scalar multiply
formula: (kA)ᵢⱼ = k · Aᵢⱼ

name: Singular value decomposition
formula: A = U·Σ·Vᵀ with U, V orthogonal and Σ diagonal of singular values

name: Solve Ax = b
formula: Solve the linear system A·x = b  (Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting)

name: Trace
formula: tr(A) = Σᵢ Aᵢᵢ  (sum of the diagonal)

name: Transpose
formula: (Aᵀ)ᵢⱼ = Aⱼᵢ

name: Vector magnitude
formula: ‖v‖ = √(v₁² + v₂² + …)

name: Vector projection
formula: proj_b(a) = (a·b / b·b) · b

name: AND
formula: A ∧ B is true only when both are true

name: Cardinality
formula: |A| = number of elements in A

name: Complement
formula: Aᶜ = elements of the universal set U not in A

name: Element of
formula: x ∈ S  — x is a member of S

name: Empty set
formula: ∅ = the set with no elements

name: For all
formula: ∀x ∈ D: P(x)  — P holds for every x in D

name: If and only if
formula: A ↔ B is true when A and B have the same truth value

name: Implies
formula: A → B is false only when A is true and B is false  (¬A ∨ B)

name: Intersection
formula: A ∩ B = elements in both A and B

name: NOT
formula: ¬A is true when A is false

name: Not element of
formula: x ∉ S  — x is not a member of S

name: OR
formula: A ∨ B is true when at least one is true

name: Proper subset
formula: A ⊂ B  — every element of A is in B and A ≠ B

name: Set difference
formula: A − B = elements of A that are not in B

name: Subset or equal
formula: A ⊆ B  — every element of A is in B

name: There exists
formula: ∃x ∈ D: P(x)  — P holds for at least one x in D

name: Union
formula: A ∪ B = elements in A or B (or both)

name: XOR
formula: A ⊕ B is true when exactly one is true

name: Bisection method
formula: Repeatedly halve [a, b] keeping the half where f changes sign

name: Convex function

formula: Hₙ = ker ∂ₙ / im ∂ₙ₊₁

name: Pendulum period
formula: T = 2π √(L / g)

name: Perihelion advance
formula: 3π Rs / (a (1 − e²)) radians per orbit, times 36525 / period_days orbits per century, times 648000/π: arcseconds per century (the general-relativity part only, not the pull of other planets)

name: Photoelectric effect
formula: K_max = h f − φ   (0 if h f < φ: no electrons are ejected)

name: Photon sphere
formula: r = 3GM/c² = 1.5 Rs   (the radius of the unstable circular orbit of a light ray)

name: PID derivative
formula: D = Kd (e − e₀) / t   (the derivative contribution)

name: PID integral state
formula: I ← I + e t   (the stored integral the robot keeps for the next step; not part of the four-row sum)

name: PID integral term
formula: Iout = Ki (I + e t)   (the integral contribution: this step's error is added before multiplying by Ki)

name: PID proportional
formula: P = Kp e   (the proportional term)

name: PID output
formula: P + I + D   (the sum of the three terms; the menu operator opens four rows joined by →, the answer is the last row)

name: Point inside a camera cone
formula: 1 when v · d > 0 and (v · d) / (|v| |d|) ≥ cos α, with v = p − c (the camera c looks along d with half-angle α; the edge counts as inside); 0 otherwise

name: Point inside a tree trunk
formula: 1 if the point is inside or on the vertical cylinder standing on z = 0 at (cx, cy), out to radius R and up to height h; 0 otherwise

name: Point inside a sphere
formula: 1 if the point is inside or on the sphere, 0 if it is outside

name: Poiseuille's law (flow in a pipe)
formula: Q = π r⁴ ΔP / (8 μ L)   (laminar flow in a round pipe)

name: Potential energy
formula: PE = m g h

name: Potential-field step
formula: F = k_att (goal − position) + F_rep;  inside the influence distance F_rep = k_rep (1/d − 1/influence)(1/d²) u, otherwise 0  (u points from the obstacle toward the robot)
compute_signature: compute(position, goal, obstacle, influence, k_att, k_rep)

name: Power (Physics)
formula: P = W / t

name: Pressure
formula: P = F / A

name: Projectile position
formula: x = v cos θ · t,  y = v sin θ · t − ½ g t²   (y is up, no drag, g = 9.81 m/s²)

name: Projectile range
formula: R = v² sin(2θ) / g   (level ground, no drag, g = 9.81 m/s², θ in radians)

name: Projectile time of flight
formula: T = 2 v sin θ / g   (back to the same height, no drag, g = 9.81 m/s², θ in radians)

name: Quantum harmonic oscillator
formula: Eₙ = ħ ω (n + ½)   (ω in rad/s)

name: Relativistic Doppler: beta
formula: β = v / c   (v > 0 receding, v < 0 approaching; the speed must be less than the speed of light)

name: Relativistic Doppler effect
formula: f = f₀ √( (1 − β)/(1 + β) ),  β = v/c   (v > 0 receding, v < 0 approaching)

name: Relativistic Doppler: frequency
formula: f = f₀ √( (1 − β)/(1 + β) )   (β is the answer of the row above)

name: Relativistic kinetic energy: from the Lorentz factor
formula: K = (γ − 1) m c²   (γ is the answer of the row above)

name: Relativistic momentum
formula: p = m v / √(1 − v²/c²)

name: Relativistic momentum: from the Lorentz factor
formula: p = γ m v   (γ is the answer of the row above)

name: Relativistic velocity addition
formula: w = (u + v) / (1 + u v / c²)

name: Resistors in parallel
formula: 1 / R_total = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂ + …

name: Resistors in series
formula: R_total = R₁ + R₂ + …

name: Reynolds number
formula: Re = ρ v L / μ   (μ = dynamic viscosity)

name: Saturation
formula: clamp(value, low, high)   (the value limited to the low and high ends)

name: Circular-orbit coordinate speed
formula: r Ω = c √(Rs / (2 r))   (the Kepler speed of a circular orbit: circumference radius times the angular speed; not the speed a hovering observer measures; r > 1.5 Rs)

name: Schwarzschild g_rr
formula: g_rr = 1 / (1 − Rs/r)   (the radial coefficient of the Schwarzschild metric outside a spherical mass; r and Rs in metres)

name: Schwarzschild g_tt
formula: g_tt = −(1 − Rs/r)   (the time coefficient of the Schwarzschild metric outside a spherical mass, signature (−, +, +, +); r and Rs in metres)

name: Circular-orbit local speed
formula: v = c √( (Rs / (2 r)) / (1 − Rs / r) )   (the speed an observer hovering at that radius measures; stable orbits only, r ≥ 3 Rs)

name: Circular-orbit angular speed
formula: Ω = c √(Rs / (2 r³))   (radians per second of coordinate time for a circular orbit around a non-spinning mass; the Kepler form; r > 1.5 Rs; c = 299792458 m/s)

name: Circular-orbit period
formula: T = 2π / Ω   (the coordinate-time period of a circular orbit around a non-spinning mass; r > 1.5 Rs)

name: Schwarzschild radius
formula: rₛ = 2 G M / c²   (G = 6.674×10⁻¹¹ N·m²/kg²)

name: Self-induced emf of an inductor
formula: ε = −L ΔI / Δt

name: Force down a slope
formula: F = m g sin θ   (the part of the weight that pulls down the slope, g = 9.81 m/s², θ in radians above the horizontal)

name: Snell's law
formula: θ₂ = arcsin(n₁ sin θ₁ / n₂)   (angles in radians)

name: Speed after a distance
formula: v = √(u² + 2 a s)   (u in m/s, a in m/s², s in metres along the line)

name: Steepest climb
formula: θ = atan μ   (the steepest slope friction μ can hold, in radians; mass and gravity cancel)

name: Stokes' drag force
formula: F = 6π μ r v   (small sphere, slow flow)

name: Stopping distance
formula: s = −u² / (2 a)   (the signed displacement until the speed is 0; a must oppose u)

name: Thin lens equation
formula: dᵢ = 1 / (1/f − 1/dₒ)   (returns the image distance, real-is-positive)

name: Time dilation
formula: Δt = Δt₀ / √(1 − v²/c²)   (Δt₀ = time measured by the moving clock)

name: Time dilation: from the Lorentz factor
formula: Δt = Δt₀ γ   (γ is the answer of the row above)

name: Time to collision
formula: t = |r| / (−(r · v) / |r|)   (r is the obstacle minus the robot, v the robot's velocity; only when the closing speed is positive)

name: Time to a distance
formula: the smallest t ≥ 0 with s = u t + ½ a t²   (s is the signed displacement)

name: Tipping margin
symbol: b cos θ − h sin θ
formula: b cos θ − h sin θ   (metres from the downhill foot to where the weight falls; positive stays upright)

name: Torque
formula: τ = r F sin θ

name: Turn radius
formula: r = v² / (g tan φ)   (a level banked turn; φ in radians, positive to the left; a negative radius turns the other way; g = 9.81 m/s²)

name: Velocity
formula: v = d / t

name: Velocity squared
formula: v = √(u² + 2 a s)

name: Volume flow rate
formula: Q = A v

name: Wave speed
formula: v = f λ

name: Weight
formula: W = m g   (g = 9.81 m/s²)

name: Work
formula: W = F d   (force parallel to displacement)
